name: Extension Core
description: The VS Code extension entry point. Activates the workbench, detects the git repo root, wires up all sidebar views, registers commands (grouped in commands/*.ts via register*Commands(ctx, deps)), and owns the lifecycle of the SessionManager and all VS Code disposables. Also hosts small shared helpers: errors.ts (errorMessage), html.ts (escapeHtml/safeJson/makeNonce), sidebarMessages.ts (runItemCommand), statePanelBase.ts (StatePanelBase for prefs panels).
guidelines: Register all commands and providers inside activate() (or a register*Commands(ctx, deps) in commands/) and push them to ctx.subscriptions so they are torn down on deactivate. activate() should read as wiring only — put new command groups in commands/*.ts.
Every registered command needs a matching contributes.commands entry in package.json.
Detect repoRoot via findRepoRoot/findRepoKey and propagate it to SessionManager and providers whenever workspace folders change.
Defer any worktree removal that requires a folder switch by persisting intent to globalState under PENDING_REMOVAL_KEY and completing it on the next activate().
When workspace folders change, notify every provider that caches repoRoot (e.g. archProvider.onRepoChanged()) so watchers re-point and panels reload.
Use errorMessage(e) from errors.ts instead of `(e as Error).message`; escapeHtml/safeJson/makeNonce come from html.ts; clampEffort from sessionTypes.
Prefs-style webview panels extend StatePanelBase and call start() at the end of their constructor; sidebar item actions dispatch through runItemCommand with a typed command map.
anti_patterns: Do not store per-session or per-worktree state directly in extension.ts — route it through SessionManager.
Do not call removeWorktree directly; always go through performWorktreeRemoval so terminal/task cleanup runs atomically.
Do not copy escapeHtml/safeJson/makeNonce or `(e as Error).message` into a new file — import the shared helpers.
decisions: Worktree removal of the active worktree is deferred across a window reload (switch folder first, persist removal intent, finish on next activate) because the VS Code extension host is killed when the workspace folder changes.
Session and page-opening commands were moved out of activate() into commands/sessionCommands.ts and commands/pageCommands.ts; pin/unpinSidebar stay inline since they use activate-local state.
